info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Airline Flights Baggages-v2-spec
info.description: The Flight Baggage Overview API provides comprehensive details about baggage associated with specific airline flights, enabling users to effectively manage baggage inquiries. This endpoint is designed to facilitate seamless access to information regarding flight baggage for travelers or airline representatives. Typical consumers include airport staff, customer service agents, and travelers looking to track or manage their baggage status. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their operational workflows and improve the overall customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about baggage associated with flights. You can use it to check the status, dimensions, and weight limits of baggage for specific flight itineraries.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve baggage information for flights. It contains parameters that specify the criteria for querying baggage details associated with specific flight operations.
